observations.intent: An entity whose own identity or characterization is a masked spirit or ghost.

evidence.name: Dalgyal Gwishin
evidence.qualification: Masked undead explicitly in root self-description.

evidence.name: Ghoul
evidence.qualification: Undead but no masked-spirit evidence.

criteria.direct: A spirit or ghost whose own characterization involves a mask is strong. A real spirit actually wearing a mask may be useful even if the mask is carried equipment rather than its essential identity; a living humanoid merely carrying a mask does not establish a masked spirit. Spirits without a mask fulfill only part of the intent. No tradition, culture, level or hostility is implied.
criteria.partial: Source-backed fulfillment of part of the intent or a constrained alternative can be useful; state missing aspects or practical limitations.
criteria.tangential: Shared vocabulary or genre alone is weak evidence. Mere mentions and associated-item copies do not establish that the owner has the requested capability. An actually owned usable capability can be directly relevant; explain the difference between retrieving that capability and retrieving its owner.
criteria.negative: No source-backed concept fit is irrelevant. Judge useful cross-family answers separately from intended family fit.
